video_title: Ayo Dosunmu Postgame Interview After Win Against Portland Trail Blazers | 11.17.26

quotes.speaker: Ayo Dosunmu
quotes.summary_phrase: Ayo Dosunmu on the game-winning play and trusting his teammates
quotes.excerpt: I trust my teammates and there's no person I'd rather have in that spot right there.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: Melo comes up with a huge steal. You get the ball. You got to walk me through that final play that gets Jaden the bucket and you guys essentially the win.

text_blocks.speaker: Ayo Dosunmu
text_blocks.text: That was a great game. That's probably one of the best games I've been a part of. I was just trying to learn from my mistakes. Kamara took two charges on me in the game, so I just wanted to learn from my mistakes throughout the game. When I got that steal, I wanted to seize the moment, and I saw Jaden there and I trust my teammates and there's no person I'd rather have in that spot right there.

quotes.social_post: Ayo Dosunmu on the game winning play: I was just trying to learn from my mistakes. When I got that steal I wanted to seize the moment and I saw Jaden there and I trust my teammates and there is no person I would rather have in that spot.

structured.context: Ayo Dosunmu describes his thought process during the final play that led to a game-winning basket by Jaden McDaniels against the Portland Trail Blazers.

quotes.speaker: Ayo Dosunmu
quotes.summary_phrase: Ayo Dosunmu on maintaining mental focus and consistency
quotes.excerpt: I'm very consistent in what I do. I'm very consistent in my approach.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified reporter
text_blocks.text: You had a tough night last night scoring-wise. You had one heck of a first half and followed it up with a big second half as well too. How were you able to just mentally lock in and fight back and have that bounce-back game?

text_blocks.speaker: Ayo Dosunmu
text_blocks.text: Just trusted in my work, believing in my faith, and having trust in my work. I'm very consistent in what I do. I'm very consistent in my approach. I didn't have the game I wanted yesterday, but we got the win and that's what's all about and I wanted to bounce back and I was very excited to do so.

quotes.social_post: Ayo Dosunmu on his bounce back performance: I just trusted in my work believing in my faith and having trust in my work. I am very consistent in what I do.

structured.context: Ayo Dosunmu explains how he maintained his mental focus and consistency following a poor scoring performance in the previous game.

quotes.speaker: Ayo Dosunmu
quotes.summary_phrase: Ayo Dosunmu praises Trey Lyles' performance during injury-riddled stretch
quotes.excerpt: He was amazing. Shout out Trey Lyles. He was the MVP tonight.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified reporter
text_blocks.text: You guys have been dealing with injuries. JK goes down, it's next man up. Tonight, he may not have had a huge scoring night, but how huge was Trey Lyles for you guys tonight?

text_blocks.speaker: Ayo Dosunmu
text_blocks.text: He was amazing. Shout out Trey Lyles. He was the MVP tonight. He made big plays, big rebound. He made two big stops right there and that's what's all about. When we down soldiers, it's always next man up mentality, so I'm very excited. It's my uncle's birthday today, so that that win was for him.

quotes.social_post: Ayo Dosunmu calls Trey Lyles the MVP of their win over Portland: He was amazing. He made big plays big rebound. He made two big stops right there and that is what it is all about.

structured.context: Ayo Dosunmu praises Trey Lyles for his contributions during a game where the team was dealing with multiple player injuries.
